messages:
Samira: Quick follow-up from the wins/losses segment — lots of Qs about why we lose enterprise deals (latency, pricing, compliance). Can leadership give a compact list of asks + next steps?
Ava (CEO): Short version: three recurring themes — committed pricing clarity, reproducible latency guarantees (regional), and simpler Private/onboarding + compliance artifacts.
Diego (Product): From deal reviews: procurement wants concrete numbers (example committed tiers + sample invoices), engineering teams want config examples, and security teams need audit/residency docs.
Lina (CS): We also heard requests for short how-to videos (5-10m) to hand to customer security teams.
Arjun (Eng): Tech note: a slice of losses are low-latency mobile profiles (p95 ~ <30ms). We can hit it with tuned runtime + KV cache, but customers need a reproducible bench and config snippets.
Noah (Sales): Procurement frequently stalls on contract language for data residency & logs. If we standardize templates, it removes friction.
Samira: Can we make these tangible: 1-page pricing examples, an SLO cookbook + 2 config snippets, Private onboarding checklist, procurement clause templates, and 2 short vids? Assign owners?
Ava (CEO): Yes. Proposal: Product -> pricing + onboarding checklist; Eng -> SLO cookbook & bench runs; CS -> validation + vids; Sales + Legal -> contract templates. Small benchmarking budget approved.
Diego (Product): I can own the pricing examples and onboarding checklist. ETA: 5 business days.
Arjun (Eng): I'll deliver the SLO cookbook (seq len 32/128/512; GPU + CPU baselines) and run regional benches. ETA: 12 business days. Include example snippet:
```
model: redwood-lowlat-v2
batch_size: 4
seq_len: 128
p95_latency: 24ms
```
Lina (CS): CS will test the artifacts with 6 recently lost prospects and capture feedback. We'll record two short walkthroughs.
Noah (Sales): I'll integrate the one-pagers into the next RFP cycle and circulate slides.
Kim (Legal): I'll draft two procurement clause variants (regulated + standard) and a short FAQ. ETA: 4 business days.
infra-bot: bench-run queued: est 10 GPU-hours across two regions; provisional cost ~$1.05k. Full quote posted in #eng-infra.
Samira: Can someone add a tiny tracker to the all-hands follow-up doc with owner, deliverable, ETA? I'll check back in 7 days.
Diego (Product): Will add tracker and link by EOD.
Ava (CEO): Thanks all. Priority order for deliverables: 1) SLO cookbook, 2) pricing examples/ROI table, 3) Private onboarding checklist, 4) procurement templates. Let's convert these into deal-closing assets.
